description: A React functional component called RoleSelector that allows users to select a role (Admin, HR, Employee) and optionally specify an assignee identifier if the role is Employee. It manages local state for selections and updates the global context upon continuation.

methods.name: RoleSelector
methods.description: React functional component for role selection with optional assignee input, handling user interactions and updating global context.

methods.name: handleContinue
methods.description: Handles the logic when the user clicks the Continue button: updates the global role and assignee identifier based on local state, and calls the optional onContinue callback.
